title: Post Effects (Library of Ruina)
description: Turns bloom back on in the Switch version. Host callbacks force the bloom of the game's v1 camera stack (UnityEngine.PostProcessing, OnPreCull) on, and with stronger settings than the game's 0.25 / threshold 1.0, and the bloom of the v2 stack (UnityEngine.Rendering.PostProcessing, Bloom.IsEnabledAndSupported) on when it is off, and log which of the game's bloom sources (v1, v2, RFX4_Bloom, RFX4_DistortionAndBloom, CameraFilterPack_Blur_Bloom) run and with what settings.

launcher.label: Post Effects (Bloom)
launcher.note: Brings back the bloom the Switch version leaves out. May cost some fps.
